definitions.explanation: the amount of water contained in food, fabric, or other materials

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水気|みずけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: Drain the moisture from the vegetables.

examples.japanese: ⟦キッチンペーパー→キッチンペーパー：25045_kicchinpeepaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{水気|みずけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}き{取|と}った→拭き取る：18690_fukitoru⟧。
examples.english: I wiped off the moisture with a paper towel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧{水気|みずけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美味|おい}しく→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦{焼|や}ける→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧。
examples.english: If you remove the moisture thoroughly before cooking meat, it will brown nicely.

notes:
{水気|みずけ} refers to the moisture or water content in food or other materials, commonly used in cooking contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水気|みずけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to drain moisture)
- {水気|みずけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to remove moisture)
- {水気|みずけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧ (to wipe off moisture)
- {水気|みずけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (has a lot of moisture)

COOKING USAGE:
- Essential term in recipes, especially when preparing salads or frying
- Removing {水気|みずけ} before frying prevents oil splatter
- For salads, draining {水気|みずけ} prevents watery dressing

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧ (moisture content - more formal/scientific)
- ⟦{湿気|しっけ}→湿気：03177_shikke⟧ (humidity, dampness in the air)
- ⟦{潤|うるお}い→潤い：08250_uruoi⟧ (moisture - positive nuance, often for skin)
